ms.promise:
Build a custom solution for Integral’s application, to surface Cardano transaction data held in Cardano wallets, by indexing account activity for specific Cardano addresses. This structure will be standard 
The ability to surface Cardano transactions from custom wallets on the Cardano chain by indexing account activity for specific Cardano addresses. This structure will be relevant to other Cardano wallets in the ecosystem as well.
ms.criteria: Acceptance criteria for this milestone would be the ability to pull transaction data from Cardano wallets and surface the data. This will be replicable for most other wallets on the Cardano in the ecosystem. The ability to show this for a few different wallets will be the acceptance criteria.

ms.promise:
Create an easy configuration that allows clients to add their Cardano wallet to the Integral UI for the transactions to upload into the system

Criteria for this would be the ability to input the wallet information the UI and have the transactions history successful load into the Integral UI and be viewable in the bookkeeping tab.
Other information will include the ability to view the historical end of day balances for that wallet as well once transactions have loaded.

ms.promise:
Outputs: 
- The transaction type 
- Pricing (USD value) 
- Timestamp of the transaction 
- Sending and receiving party of the transaction
- Balances held with wallets
ms.criteria: The ability to export reports for Cardano wallets added in the UI that include the above transaction details.
ms.report:
LOOM VIDEO:
In the below loom video I walk through an account where we have added a native Cardano addresses, we show the link through to the Cardano scan show this is a native wallet and the thousands of transactions we have brought in and the balances within each of those walelts. From there we go to the wallet tab to show the detailled summary of the wallet available to clients for each wallet, as well as the date range of transactions brought-in. After that the bookkeeping tab in the app that shows the transactions themselves, I filtered to a few smaller wallets that have less transactions to make it easier to see the transactions themselves. You can clearly see the transactions type (eg deposit, withdrawal, feesetc.) and parties involved. Once I click into the transaction details to show the time stamp of the transaction, the pricing time stamp of the transactions as well in USD - all per the stated outputs above! We walk next to the reporting tab to show the various transaction and balance reports available for clients to pull as well. 
The second video walks through the process to export a report and it's linked below.
